```yaml
name: Check Spy Versions

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-spy-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check spy versions consistency
        run: ./ci/check-spy-versions.sh
```
